metrics.rmse_pw: Pixel-weighted RMSE over finite valid pair pixels.
metrics.ssim_pw: Pixel-weighted masked SSIM. Local SSIM windows use only finite task-valid pixels; LoS/NLoS scopes select center pixels for aggregation.
metrics.map_corr: Per-sample/per-scope Pearson correlation over finite valid pixels, aggregated by valid-pixel count.
metrics.grad_mag_corr: Per-sample/per-scope Pearson correlation between gradient magnitudes. Gradients use finite task-valid neighborhoods; LoS/NLoS scopes select center pixels for aggregation.

ssim.directml_note: When the model device is DirectML/non-CPU/non-CUDA, SSIM local-window maps are computed on CPU for backend compatibility.
